name: Okoljska dajatev za onesnaževanje zraka z emisijo CO2 on diesel
law: Uredba o okoljski dajatvi za onesnaževanje zraka z emisijo ogljikovega dioksida (Uradni list RS 48/18) art. 3: the charge is an amount per unit of burden, one tonne of CO2; for plinsko olje (diesel) it is 17.3 euro, from Uredba 48/18 (until the government's sklep). Fuel suppliers pay it and pass it on in the fuel price.

sources.title: Uredba o okoljski dajatvi za onesnaževanje zraka z emisijo ogljikovega dioksida (Uradni list RS 48/18), its text as published (PISRS): one unit = 1 tonne of CO2; 17.3 euro until a government sklep
